title: AMD Ventures co-leads Vultr's $333M round

sources.quote: LuminArx Capital Management and AMD Ventures jointly led the investment.

The company today announced a fresh $333 million investment led by AMD Ventures and LuminArx Capital Management, vaulting it to a $3.5 billion valuation, becoming a key player in the race to dominate AI infrastructure.

explain: AMD's venture arm co-led a $333 million funding round in cloud provider Vultr at a $3.5 billion valuation. AMD's own share was not disclosed; Vultr uses AMD GPUs, so AMD is backing a chip buyer.
